HEADLINE: Sector Update: Tech

BODY:
08:56 AM EST, 01/08/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Technology stocks were leaning lower premarket Thursday, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLK) down 0.3% and the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) declining by 0.3%.

Alphabet (GOOG) shares were up more than 1% pre-bell. Alphabet has become the world's second-most valuable publicly traded company with a market cap of $3.892 trillion in recent premarket activity Thursday, overtaking Apple (AAPL) with $3.863 trillion.
text: Apple has slipped to third place among the world's most valuable public companies, as Alphabet's premarket rally pushed its market cap to $3.892 trillion, edging out Apple's $3.863 trillion. This shift occurred amid a broader pullback in tech stocks, with the XLK and XSD ETFs both down 0.3% premarket Thursday. While the overall sector softness reflects modest risk-off sentiment, the more notable development for Apple investors is the narrowing valuation gap with Alphabet, signaling shifting market confidence in AI-driven growth narratives and increased competitive pressure on Apple's premium position among mega-cap tech peers.
